# Confirm home undo restores every starting status without losing details

## What & Why
The home shortcut can act on opportunities in several actionable statuses. Coverage should verify that undo returns each supported starting status, not just Saved, while retaining the URL, priority, next action, notes, and role.

## Done looks like
- The browser test covers undo from Preparing and Follow up (or equivalent actionable statuses)
- Each opportunity returns to its exact prior status
- Complete opportunity details remain available after reload
